location.name: The bungalow by the sea (skeleton)
location.description: A semantic-only stand-in for the bungalow home build (WLD-05a). It exists so that the resident record and the fabric can resolve every thing they need before the house is built, and as the list of what the real sidecar must contain. The plan (a small invented layout: the kitchen in the south with the bench to its east and the bedroom to its north) only gives the anchors positions; the ids, classes, states and uses of the required items are the agreement. The real sidecar keeps these ids.
